title: Implement notifications UI + backend
labels:

## Summary

Add a notifications area to the site and support notifications from the backend so users and admins can see updates.

## Requirements

- Add a notification panel or section in the UI.
- Add backend support for fetching notifications.
- Optionally, allow admin users to post new notifications.

## Notes

Static notifications are not enough; this issue should make notifications part of the app experience.
